structure: Part 1 mined all 21 traces of repos/trade-imports-ins-frontend/src/server/app/features/address-book/fit/add.fit.spec.js (spec read in full, with its helper address-form.js for the labels and messages the tests drive). The Playwright CLI that tim runs refused these zips (TraceVersionError: trace created by a newer Playwright), so each trace was read from its already-unpacked copy in this part's work folder (render, axe, req-name, req-line1, req-town, req-postcode, req-country, req-phone, req-email, max-name, max-line1, max-line2, max-town, max-county, max-postcode, max-phone, max-email, bad-email, err-axe, save, cancel): actions from 1-trace.trace 'before' events, the network log from 1-trace.network, and every frame snapshot rendered to HTML with a jq filter (render.jq), plus test.trace for the axe results. Refs below name the trace by its folder hash (for example a-31686) and the action's callId. Pages, in order: (1) stub sign-in GET /auth/stub-sign-in?organisationId=... which 302s to / ('Dashboard | Import notification service'), always, as the harness entry; (2) the add address page GET /address-book/add, 'Add address details', always: two H2 sections ('Enter address details': Name or organisation name, Address line 1, Address line 2 (optional), Town or city, County (optional), Postcode or Zip code, Country select; 'Enter contact details': Email address, Phone number with hint), then 'Save and continue' and 'Cancel and return to address book' buttons; (3) the same page in its error state, conditional on a failed submit (POST returns 400, title prefixed 'Error: ', error summary 'There is a problem' with one link per error, inline error message, value preserved): driven for 7 empty required fields, 8 over-length fields and 1 malformed email, one error per trace; (4) the address book list GET /address-book after a successful save (POST 302) with the 'Success' notification banner and the new row, or after cancel (POST 302, no banner, nothing created). Two traces ran axe on page 2 and page 3: both reported zero serious or critical violations. The add page and its error state are built entirely from govuk-frontend components (Input, Select, Hint, Error summary, Error message, Button, secondary Button, Button group); no non-govuk class appears inside main. No caption and no back link render on the add page. The country list held only 4 countries. No backend call is visible: the frontend's calls to the address book service are server side and leave no trace in the browser network log.
